content.name: Tireless
entries: Primal forces now help fuel you on your journeys, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can give yourself a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Decrease Exhaustion
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52}, your {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level, if any, decreases by 1.
